summary: Minimal allowed Bun adaptations turn 40 of ticket 04's 41 failing root-suite files into passes. Residual: src/main/plugins/pluginExternalWorkspace.test.ts (Bun 1.4.2 cannot install a consumer whose file: tarball peers are other file: dependencies; measured minimal repro). Node control on the adapted source is fully green and identical to the frozen baseline. TokenMonitorApp panic explained as a downstream symptom of the unanchored relative vi.mock and resolved by the anchor.

adaptations.why: Vitest recovers the importer for a relative vi.mock id from a stack frame spelled `at Object.mock (...)`; Bun prints `at mock (...)` so the importer is empty and the mock never matches. The helper recovers the caller file, resolves the id against it, and delegates a pre-anchored id. Absolute/bare specifiers pass through; gated on process.versions.bun so Node is inert.
Registers the anchor as setupFiles for every project; one line plus its comment.

Under Bun the packed-consumer vue-tsc entry is routed to the repository's existing scripts/bun/vue-tsc.cjs adapter (same installed package); Node keeps the consumer entry. No assertion, case or artifact changed.

Bun accepts Node's --import flag but never applies the preload, so the win32 simulation was inert. Under Bun the identical payload is written as a real preload module inside the fixture and passed with --preload; Node keeps --import. Assertions and cases unchanged.

residual.classification: Bun 1.4.2 limitation: a consumer whose file: tarball has a non-optional peer that is also one of the consumer's file: dependencies cannot be installed; Bun looks the peer up on the registry (404 for private names) or fails offline with a missing cached manifest. --omit=peer, bunfig [install] peer = false, and online mode all reproduce.
residual.required_fix: a Bun fix or a test redesign (consumer manifest/install shape); both outside this round's authority
residual.daily_path_consequence: no Node/pnpm fallback was added; the external consumer-worker substance is issue 05's Node/npm/pnpm matrix
